citations.title: A review of sourdough starters: ecology, practices, and sensory quality with applications for baking and recommendations for future research

citations.title: Sourdough starters exhibit similar succession patterns but develop flour-specific climax communities

citations.citation: Dr. Ferjoo internal rule prior: ratio-specific peak-time windows at 25–28°C.

citations.title: The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes
citations.citation: Landis EA et al. The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes. eLife. 2021;10:e61644. doi:10.7554/eLife.61644.
citations.supports: Five hundred household starters showed substantial microbiome and functional diversity, including variation in rise rate and aroma.
citations.displayNote: 说明不同家庭酵种的膨胀速度和微生物组成差异很大，因此连续观察比单次阈值更可靠。

citations.title: Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough
citations.citation: Minervini F, De Angelis M, Di Cagno R, Gobbetti M. Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough. Int J Food Microbiol. 2014;171:136–146. doi:10.1016/j.ijfoodmicro.2013.11.021.
citations.supports: Fermentation time, temperature, inoculum, flour composition, and house microbiota can affect diversity and stability; constant process settings do not guarantee identical microbiota.
citations.displayNote: 支持把时间、温度、面粉与维护环境一起理解，而不是把单一数值当成固定标准。

citations.supports: Raw flour, dough, and starter should not be tasted; baking/cooking is the microbial kill step.
citations.displayNote: 说明面粉属于生食材，生酵种不应直接品尝，充分烘烤才是最终加热步骤。

result.expectedHours: 当前阶段不使用统一翻倍估时
reasons: 第 1-2 天菌群尚在建立，短期内无明显体积变化可以出现

citations.supports: Five hundred household starters showed substantial microbiome and functional diversity, including variation in rise rate and aroma.
citations.displayNote: 说明不同家庭酵种的膨胀速度和微生物组成差异很大，因此连续观察比单次阈值更可靠。

citations.title: Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough
citations.citation: Minervini F, De Angelis M, Di Cagno R, Gobbetti M. Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough. Int J Food Microbiol. 2014;171:136–146. doi:10.1016/j.ijfoodmicro.2013.11.021.
citations.supports: Fermentation time, temperature, inoculum, flour composition, and house microbiota can affect diversity and stability; constant process settings do not guarantee identical microbiota.
citations.displayNote: 支持把时间、温度、面粉与维护环境一起理解，而不是把单一数值当成固定标准。

citations.title: Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts
citations.citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts. 2023.
citations.supports: Raw flour, dough, and starter should not be tasted; baking/cooking is the microbial kill step.
citations.displayNote: 说明面粉属于生食材，生酵种不应直接品尝，充分烘烤才是最终加热步骤。

result.tempNote: 高温风险，不做线性估时
result.expectedHours: 当前阶段不使用统一翻倍估时
reasons: 当前温度高于 32℃；不同酵种微生物对高温的反应并不一致，不能再简单按“越热越快”估算时间。
第 1-2 天菌群尚在建立，短期内无明显体积变化可以出现
actions: 先将酵种移至更稳定的 25–28℃ 环境，再从降温时点重新记录体积与时间。
保持容器清洁并松盖，维持稳定温暖环境后观察 24 小时
记录气泡、气味与体积变化，不要品尝生酵种
次日继续按 1:1:1 的固定节奏喂养

citations.supports: Raw flour, dough, and starter should not be tasted; baking/cooking is the microbial kill step.
citations.displayNote: 说明面粉属于生食材，生酵种不应直接品尝，充分烘烤才是最终加热步骤。

result.expectedHours: 当前阶段不使用统一翻倍估时
reasons: 第 1-2 天菌群尚在建立，短期内无明显体积变化可以出现
起种早期表面液体与强烈酸味可能伴随菌群快速更替，需继续观察是否出现真正污染信号
actions: 若无异色/霉变，可倒掉液体或搅匀后继续按 1:1:1 喂养
保持容器清洁并松盖，维持稳定温暖环境后观察 24 小时
记录气泡、气味与体积变化，不要品尝生酵种
次日继续按 1:1:1 的固定节奏喂养

citations.citation: Landis EA et al. The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes. eLife. 2021;10:e61644. doi:10.7554/eLife.61644.

citations.supports: Temperature, hydration, ingredients, and refeeding practices can change microbial ecology, activity, metabolites, and sensory outcomes.
citations.displayNote: 综述了温度、含水量、原料与维护方式如何共同影响酵种表现。

citations.title: Sourdough starters exhibit similar succession patterns but develop flour-specific climax communities
citations.citation: McKenney EA et al. Sourdough starters exhibit similar succession patterns but develop flour-specific climax communities. PeerJ. 2023;11:e16163. doi:10.7717/peerj.16163.
citations.supports: Forty starters from ten flours followed succession over 14 days; maturity markers were protocol-dependent and flour-specific differences remained.
citations.displayNote: 支持“新起种会经历阶段性变化”，且不同面粉最终表现仍可能不同。

citations.citation: Dr. Ferjoo internal rule prior: ratio-specific peak-time windows at 25–28°C.
citations.supports: The displayed ratio × temperature time window is an empirical prior, not a universal literature constant.

citations.title: The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes
citations.citation: Landis EA et al. The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes. eLife. 2021;10:e61644. doi:10.7554/eLife.61644.
citations.supports: Five hundred household starters showed substantial microbiome and functional diversity, including variation in rise rate and aroma.
citations.displayNote: 说明不同家庭酵种的膨胀速度和微生物组成差异很大，因此连续观察比单次阈值更可靠。

citations.title: Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough
citations.citation: Minervini F, De Angelis M, Di Cagno R, Gobbetti M. Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough. Int J Food Microbiol. 2014;171:136–146. doi:10.1016/j.ijfoodmicro.2013.11.021.
citations.supports: Fermentation time, temperature, inoculum, flour composition, and house microbiota can affect diversity and stability; constant process settings do not guarantee identical microbiota.
citations.displayNote: 支持把时间、温度、面粉与维护环境一起理解，而不是把单一数值当成固定标准。

citations.title: Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts
citations.citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts. 2023.
citations.supports: Raw flour, dough, and starter should not be tasted; baking/cooking is the microbial kill step.

citations.supports: pH 4.6 as an acidification reference; discard colored/fuzzy mold; an alcoholic liquid layer alone can be a fermentation by-product.

citations.title: Sourdough starters exhibit similar succession patterns but develop flour-specific climax communities

citations.supports: Forty starters from ten flours followed succession over 14 days; maturity markers were protocol-dependent and flour-specific differences remained.
citations.displayNote: 支持“新起种会经历阶段性变化”，且不同面粉最终表现仍可能不同。

citations.citation: Dr. Ferjoo internal rule prior: ratio-specific peak-time windows at 25–28°C.

citations.title: The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes
citations.citation: Landis EA et al. The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes. eLife. 2021;10:e61644. doi:10.7554/eLife.61644.
citations.supports: Five hundred household starters showed substantial microbiome and functional diversity, including variation in rise rate and aroma.
citations.displayNote: 说明不同家庭酵种的膨胀速度和微生物组成差异很大，因此连续观察比单次阈值更可靠。

citations.title: Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough

citations.citation: McKenney EA et al. Sourdough starters exhibit similar succession patterns but develop flour-specific climax communities. PeerJ. 2023;11:e16163. doi:10.7717/peerj.16163.

citations.title: Effects of process parameters on growth and metabolism of Lactobacillus sanfranciscensis and Candida humilis during rye sourdough fermentation
citations.citation: Brandt MJ, Hammes WP, Gänzle MG. Effects of process parameters on growth and metabolism of Lactobacillus sanfranciscensis and Candida humilis during rye sourdough fermentation. Eur Food Res Technol. 2004;218:333–338. doi:10.1007/s00217-003-0867-0.

citations.title: A review of sourdough starters: ecology, practices, and sensory quality with applications for baking and recommendations for future research

citations.citation: Landis EA et al. The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes. eLife. 2021;10:e61644. doi:10.7554/eLife.61644.

citations.supports: Five hundred household starters showed substantial microbiome and functional diversity, including variation in rise rate and aroma.
citations.displayNote: 说明不同家庭酵种的膨胀速度和微生物组成差异很大，因此连续观察比单次阈值更可靠。

citations.title: Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough
citations.citation: Minervini F, De Angelis M, Di Cagno R, Gobbetti M. Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough. Int J Food Microbiol. 2014;171:136–146. doi:10.1016/j.ijfoodmicro.2013.11.021.
citations.supports: Fermentation time, temperature, inoculum, flour composition, and house microbiota can affect diversity and stability; constant process settings do not guarantee identical microbiota.
citations.displayNote: 支持把时间、温度、面粉与维护环境一起理解，而不是把单一数值当成固定标准。

citations.title: Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts
citations.citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts. 2023.
citations.supports: Raw flour, dough, and starter should not be tasted; baking/cooking is the microbial kill step.
citations.displayNote: 说明面粉属于生食材，生酵种不应直接品尝，充分烘烤才是最终加热步骤。

result.stageLabel: 复活恢复期（冷藏/冷冻后）
result.tempNote: 高温风险，不做线性估时
result.expectedHours: 当前阶段不使用统一翻倍估时
reasons: 当前温度高于 32℃；不同酵种微生物对高温的反应并不一致，不能再简单按“越热越快”估算时间。
冷藏/冷冻后的酵种通常需要回温并通过连续刷新恢复活性
actions: 先将酵种移至更稳定的 25–28℃ 环境，再从降温时点重新记录体积与时间。
回温后连续规律喂养，直到至少连续两个周期表现稳定
若多次刷新仍无反应，重点检查温度、面粉/水状态与污染迹象

citations.supports: Temperature, hydration, ingredients, and refeeding practices can change microbial ecology, activity, metabolites, and sensory outcomes.
citations.displayNote: 综述了温度、含水量、原料与维护方式如何共同影响酵种表现。

citations.citation: Dr. Ferjoo internal rule prior: ratio-specific peak-time windows at 25–28°C.

citations.title: The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes
citations.citation: Landis EA et al. The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes. eLife. 2021;10:e61644. doi:10.7554/eLife.61644.
citations.supports: Five hundred household starters showed substantial microbiome and functional diversity, including variation in rise rate and aroma.
citations.displayNote: 说明不同家庭酵种的膨胀速度和微生物组成差异很大，因此连续观察比单次阈值更可靠。

citations.title: Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough
citations.citation: Minervini F, De Angelis M, Di Cagno R, Gobbetti M. Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough. Int J Food Microbiol. 2014;171:136–146. doi:10.1016/j.ijfoodmicro.2013.11.021.
citations.supports: Fermentation time, temperature, inoculum, flour composition, and house microbiota can affect diversity and stability; constant process settings do not guarantee identical microbiota.
citations.displayNote: 支持把时间、温度、面粉与维护环境一起理解，而不是把单一数值当成固定标准。

citations.title: Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts
citations.citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts. 2023.
citations.supports: Raw flour, dough, and starter should not be tasted; baking/cooking is the microbial kill step.

citations.supports: Five hundred household starters showed substantial microbiome and functional diversity, including variation in rise rate and aroma.
citations.displayNote: 说明不同家庭酵种的膨胀速度和微生物组成差异很大，因此连续观察比单次阈值更可靠。

citations.title: Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough
citations.citation: Minervini F, De Angelis M, Di Cagno R, Gobbetti M. Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough. Int J Food Microbiol. 2014;171:136–146. doi:10.1016/j.ijfoodmicro.2013.11.021.
citations.supports: Fermentation time, temperature, inoculum, flour composition, and house microbiota can affect diversity and stability; constant process settings do not guarantee identical microbiota.
citations.displayNote: 支持把时间、温度、面粉与维护环境一起理解，而不是把单一数值当成固定标准。

citations.title: Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts
citations.citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts. 2023.
citations.supports: Raw flour, dough, and starter should not be tasted; baking/cooking is the microbial kill step.
citations.displayNote: 说明面粉属于生食材，生酵种不应直接品尝，充分烘烤才是最终加热步骤。

result.stageLabel: 复活恢复期（冷藏/冷冻后）
result.tempNote: 高温风险，不做线性估时
result.expectedHours: 当前阶段不使用统一翻倍估时
reasons: 当前温度高于 32℃；不同酵种微生物对高温的反应并不一致，不能再简单按“越热越快”估算时间。
冷藏/冷冻后的酵种通常需要回温并通过连续刷新恢复活性
actions: 先将酵种移至更稳定的 25–28℃ 环境，再从降温时点重新记录体积与时间。
回温后连续规律喂养，直到至少连续两个周期表现稳定
若多次刷新仍无反应，重点检查温度、面粉/水状态与污染迹象

citations.title: The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes
citations.citation: Landis EA et al. The diversity and function of sourdough starter microbiomes. eLife. 2021;10:e61644. doi:10.7554/eLife.61644.

citations.supports: Five hundred household starters showed substantial microbiome and functional diversity, including variation in rise rate and aroma.
citations.displayNote: 说明不同家庭酵种的膨胀速度和微生物组成差异很大，因此连续观察比单次阈值更可靠。

citations.title: Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough
citations.citation: Minervini F, De Angelis M, Di Cagno R, Gobbetti M. Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough. Int J Food Microbiol. 2014;171:136–146. doi:10.1016/j.ijfoodmicro.2013.11.021.
citations.supports: Fermentation time, temperature, inoculum, flour composition, and house microbiota can affect diversity and stability; constant process settings do not guarantee identical microbiota.
citations.displayNote: 支持把时间、温度、面粉与维护环境一起理解，而不是把单一数值当成固定标准。

citations.title: Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts
citations.citation: U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts. 2023.
citations.supports: Raw flour, dough, and starter should not be tasted; baking/cooking is the microbial kill step.
citations.displayNote: 说明面粉属于生食材，生酵种不应直接品尝，充分烘烤才是最终加热步骤。

reasons: 膨胀 3 倍以上说明发酵非常强，已明显超出常规翻倍观察点，风味与结构更容易进入过峰状态
actions: 尽快使用或刷新，不要继续长时间放置

citations.supports: Raw flour, dough, and starter should not be tasted; baking/cooking is the microbial kill step.
citations.displayNote: 说明面粉属于生食材，生酵种不应直接品尝，充分烘烤才是最终加热步骤。

reasons: 膨胀 3 倍以上说明发酵非常强，已明显超出常规翻倍观察点，风味与结构更容易进入过峰状态
actions: 尽快使用或刷新，不要继续长时间放置
下轮可用更高喂养比例或降低温度来拉长峰值窗口

citations.title: Effects of process parameters on growth and metabolism of Lactobacillus sanfranciscensis and Candida humilis during rye sourdough fermentation
citations.citation: Brandt MJ, Hammes WP, Gänzle MG. Effects of process parameters on growth and metabolism of Lactobacillus sanfranciscensis and Candida humilis during rye sourdough fermentation. Eur Food Res Technol. 2004;218:333–338. doi:10.1007/s00217-003-0867-0.

citations.supports: Five hundred household starters showed substantial microbiome and functional diversity, including variation in rise rate and aroma.

citations.title: Ecological parameters influencing microbial diversity and stability of traditional sourdough

citations.supports: Fermentation time, temperature, inoculum, flour composition, and house microbiota can affect diversity and stability; constant process settings do not guarantee identical microbiota.

citations.title: Flour Is a Raw Food and Other Safety Facts

result.expectedHours: 高温下不建议估时（先降至 ≤32℃）
reasons: 当前温度高于 32℃；不同酵种微生物对高温的反应并不一致，不能再简单按“越热越快”估算时间。
尚未提供喂养后经过时间，当前高度不足以区分“观察尚早”和“活性偏慢”。
actions: 先将酵种移至更稳定的 25–28℃ 环境，再从降温时点重新记录体积与时间。
补充喂养时刻或已观察小时数，再与该比例、温度的经验窗口比较。
在确认超过窗口前，不要频繁补喂打断观察曲线。
